noneuclid.impossibleSpace: The Region is bigger or smaller on the inside: movement through it costs more or less than its drawn size.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.hint: Log extra details about portals and other non-Euclidean effects to the browser console.

scale.label: Inside Scale
scale.hint: How many times longer distances are inside the Region. 2 means bigger on the inside; 0.5 means smaller.

WallPortal.Hint: Turn this wall into a portal. Walking across it continues the walk out of the exit wall, and looking at it shows what lies beyond the exit. Portal walls never block sight or movement themselves.
WallPortal.ExitHint: Pick the wall on the map, or paste a wall's UUID to lead to another Scene. Leave empty to make this an ordinary wall again.
WallPortal.Pick: Pick the exit wall on the map
WallPortal.PickPrompt: Click the exit wall. Press Escape or right-click to cancel.
WallPortal.PickMissed: No wall there. Click closer to a wall, or press Escape to cancel.
WallPortal.FlipHint: Come out of the exit heading the opposite way.
WallPortal.TwoWayHint: Make the exit wall a portal leading back here.
WallPortal.NoCrossScenePermission: You do not have permission to move Tokens between Scenes.
